role: CI gate (make xcodebuild-pinned-guard, a prerequisite of make ci; gates.yml 'Documentation, SBOM, no phone-home, pinned packages'; ci.yml lint-and-budgets 'Every xcodebuild run uses the committed package versions') that fails when any xcodebuild invocation in the Makefile, a workflow, a script or a git hook that opens the project lacks -onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile.
toplevel: set -uo pipefail; cd to repo root. Python: scripts/lib/xcodebuild.sh or Makefile missing -> exit 2. The library must contain the line `XCODEBUILD_PINNED=-onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile`, else exit 1. No workflow or no script found -> exit 2. Scans the Makefile, every workflow, scripts/*.sh, scripts/lib/*.sh and every .githooks file: drops whole-line comments and trailing ` # ` comments, joins backslash continuations into one logical line numbered by its first line, and finds xcodebuild in command position (line start, after ; & | ( { ! @ - or $(, after `run:`, or after then/do/else/if/exec/time/command/env/xcrun); a mention in prose or an echo string is not one. The invocation runs to the first &&, ||, ;, ` | `, trailing | or closing ). Invocations naming -version, -showsdks, -help, -usage, -license, -exportArchive, -exportNotarizedApp, -downloadPlatform, -downloadAllPlatforms, -importPlatform, -runFirstLaunch or -checkFirstLaunchStatus open no project and are counted as exempt. Any other invocation passes when it contains the literal flag; in the Makefile it may pass $(XCODEBUILD_PINNED) only if the Makefile has `include scripts/lib/xcodebuild.sh`, and in a script or hook $XCODEBUILD_PINNED / ${XCODEBUILD_PINNED} only if it sources "$(dirname "$0")/lib/xcodebuild.sh" (or is the library); a workflow must pass the literal flag. A variable without its include/source is reported as expanding to nothing. Zero checked invocations -> exit 2 (it read nothing). Any failure -> lists each as path:line with the invocation, prints how to pass the flag, exit 1. Else prints the counts of checked and exempt invocations, exit 0.
